name: Writing Tools
description: Spelling, grammar, phrasing, dictionary and thesaurus support while composing chat messages, posts and comments, in British or American English: a 120,000-word dictionary per language with frequency-ranked corrections, 99 grammar rules and 109 phrasing suggestions that explain what is wrong and why, four checks that count across a whole message, and definitions and synonyms covering 86% of the dictionary. Fully local -- all datasets ship inside the plugin, and it never sees a word you type.
